title: Where and in what form do Tracker records live?
question: Where and in what form do Tracker records live?
answer:
LD-22: Use workbench/landmark-tracker/ with generated TRACKER.json and flat destination-questions/ and landmarks/ JSON records; Wiki explanations are Markdown. Earlier status-folder and root proposals are superseded or unselected.
LD-22A: Current approved layout: workbench/landmark-tracker/ containing generated TRACKER.json and flat JSON destination-questions/ and landmarks/. Root from decision-012, question folder revised by decision-023.
LD-6: Landmarks and questions both get WBIDs; legacy question labels stay readable.

confirmation.basis: Each source answer was owner-settled in its grilling session, per the grilling ledger at 56b459da: LD-22, LD-22A, LD-6 (locked). The card's grouping, title and synthesis are agent work (2026-09-26 draft grouping and the 2026-10-01 ledger backfill), not separately owner-confirmed.
